rationale.max_model_len: Reduce KV-cache pressure for short text-to-SQL prompts.
rationale.max_num_seqs: Conservative concurrency cap to reduce tail latency and timeouts under overload.
rationale.max_num_batched_tokens: Bound per-step batch size to control latency while preserving batching.
rationale.gpu_memory_utilization: Use most H100 memory while leaving operational headroom.
rationale.enable_prefix_caching: Reuse repeated prompt/schema prefixes to reduce prefill cost.
